faqs.q: What is the model number of this Roger Series station?
faqs.a: This unit is the Avon Fitness RG-914. Quote that model number when you request a quotation so we price the exact configuration.

faqs.q: What are the dimensions of the RG-914 Lateral Raise?
faqs.a: The catalogue footprint is 1200x1300x1600 mm (length x width x height). Allow additional clearance around the unit for safe use and servicing.

faqs.q: How much does it weigh?
faqs.a: Net and gross weights are 180 Kg. / 220 Kg. 37. Gross weight includes packing, which matters for lift access and floor loading.

faqs.q: What is the weight stack rating?
faqs.a: The selectorised stack is rated at 100 Kg.

faqs.q: Is this suitable for a commercial gym?
faqs.a: Yes — this unit sits in the Avon commercial range, which is specified for continuous use on a paying gym floor.

faqs.q: Do you deliver and install in Maharashtra?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle delivery, installation and commissioning across Maharashtra — Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Nagpur and the rest of the state — and supply pan-India on project orders.

faqs.q: How do I get a price for this Roger Series station?
faqs.a: Send an enquiry with your city and quantity, or message us on WhatsApp. Pricing depends on configuration, quantity and site, so we quote per project rather than publishing a list price.
